title: Skill drawer — status chips and setup route

steps.headline: Are these green, amber and red chips the status treatment you meant?
steps.changed: The cards now borrow the session switcher's tinted chip, colored dot and plain text: green for Automatic, amber for Manual use, red for Unavailable. The text stays readable without depending on color alone.
steps.notice: The unavailable card remains greyed out but is clickable; it no longer tries to run the missing skill.
steps.risk: The statuses are sample data until project availability is implemented.

steps.path: Browse skills → unavailable Writing helper → Projects → Skills & tools
steps.headline: Clicking the unavailable card opens its project's setup section.
steps.changed: The drawer closes and Projects opens on Skills & tools, scrolled to the missing personal skill and server rows rather than the top of the page.
steps.notice: The available action is Add locally for a personal skill, or Set up locally for a server; missing files and credentials are not silently installed or synced.
steps.risk: This navigation is workbench-only. The Add/Set up buttons and per-project lookup still need real implementation.
